svg.title: Piyush Raj versus BUG_4041
svg.desc: A looping fighting-game duel beside Piyush Raj's profile card. A katana-wielding developer clashes with a glitch bug, takes one hit, jumps over it, lands a three-hit combo and finishes it with a hotfix. His skill bars fill as he wins. Open to backend, platform and software engineering roles.
